Additional Security Domains

  • Harden AWS services (Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, SNS) with least-privilege IAM and secure key management.
  • Improve Kubernetes security posture (RBAC, pod security, image scanning, runtime monitoring).
  • Deploy and operate a SIEM framework; develop detection rules, dashboards, and incident playbooks.

Overview

Security Engineer role at LEDN is a hands-on engineering position focused on application security, authentication/identity, and confidential computing. The role strengthens the security of our Bitcoin-backed loan platform and drives both tactical improvements and long-term strategy for securing applications and authentication systems. The team works with JavaScript/TypeScript services, AWS serverless stack (Lambda, API Gateway, Cognito, SNS, SQS), MongoDB and Kubernetes microservices, and evolves the authentication layer toward modern, phishing-resistant approaches. The role also involves designing and operating AWS Nitro Enclaves to protect critical data and cryptographic operations in isolated, verifiable environments. This is a product- and infrastructure-facing role with direct impact on security and customer trust.

Responsibilities

  • Lead secure design and code reviews across engineering teams.
  • Define and enforce secure coding practices for JavaScript/TypeScript services.
  • Automate vulnerability detection (SAST, SCA, DAST) within CI/CD.

  • Collaborate with Product to align usability, compliance, and security in authentication flows.
  • Define secure approaches to session management, device trust, and account recovery.
  • Design enclave-based architectures to isolate and protect sensitive workloads using AWS Nitro Enclaves; migrate high-value operations into enclave environments.

  • Harden AWS services (Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, SNS) with least-privilege IAM and secure key management.
  • Improve Kubernetes security posture (RBAC, pod security, image scanning, runtime monitoring).
  • Deploy and operate a SIEM framework; develop detection rules, dashboards, and incident playbooks.
  • Support compliance initiatives (SOC 2, ISO 27001) with security controls and documentation.

Qualifications

  • 10 years minimum of proven experience in Application Security with a focus on web and cloud-native applications.
  • Strong knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript/Golang/Python and modern web vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10, auth bypasses, business logic flaws).
  • Expertise with AWS security best practices, particularly in serverless architectures.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS Nitro Enclaves for confidential computing.
  • Deep understanding of authentication and authorization standards (OAuth2, OIDC, WebAuthn, FIDO2).
  • Practical experience with Cognito / Auth0 (MFA, custom flows, secure session handling).
  • Background in SIEM design and log correlation across cloud and application layers.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes security (RBAC, pod security, admission controls, image scanning).
  • Experience with Secure Code Review and understanding of software supply chain.
  • Deep understanding of Linux internals; ability to remediate vulnerabilities identified in penetration tests.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, able to influence engineering and product teams.

Nice To Haves

  • Familiarity with Bitcoin custody and key management practices.
  • Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code security (Terraform, AWS CDK).
  • Prior work on user-facing security features such as passwordless authentication, recovery flows, or device trust.

Culture Fit

  • Leadership mindset, adaptable and resilient in a startup or tech environment; values-driven collaboration.
  • Builder mindset to create, iterate, and scale IS practices.
  • Ability to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.
  • Integrity and accountability in managing confidential information across diverse contexts.
  • Experience working in a remote environment.

What We Provide

  • Remote-friendly policy allowing work from anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).

Additional Information

Na Dexco, valorizamos a diversidade e, de maneira sustentável, trabalhamos para nos tornarmos uma empresa inclusiva e de alta performance. Esta vaga, portanto, é prioritária parapessoas pretas, pardas ou indígenas/pessoas com deficiência reforçando nosso compromisso com a Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão .

Buscamos uma(um) Engenheira(o) de Dados Especialista para a unidade de negócio Corporativo.

Com o propósito de oferecer Soluções para Melhor Viver, nós somos parte do dia a dia das cidades e da vida das pessoas por meio das marcas Deca, Hydra, Ceusa, Portinari, Durafloor, Duratex e Castelatto.

Se você tem atitude de dono, acredita na liderança pelo exemplo e tem interesse em fazer parte de um ambiente colaborativo, que fomenta a inovação e acredita na diversidade, o seu ambiente é aqui na Dexco.

Inscreva-se e venha fazer parte da nossa jornada de transformação!

Sobre a Unidade de Negócio Madeira:

Nós somos a maior produtora de painéis de madeira industrializada do Hemisfério Sul e oferecemos soluções em painéis de madeira, pisos laminados, vinílicos e rodapés. Somos comprometidos com qualidade, design, sustentabilidade e tecnologia, e ofertamos aos nossos clientes e consumidores um portfólio de alternativas para os seus ambientes.

Design, qualidade e inovação sempre foram conceitos que diferenciaram a Deca ao longo de sua história. São eles que fazem da empresa a maior fabricante de louças e metais sanitários do Hemisfério Sul e líder no mercado brasileiro, além de exportadora para os quatro continentes. Investindo constantemente em pesquisa e desenvolvimento tecnológico, a Deca se preocupa em oferecer produtos e soluções para clientes e consumidores, sempre buscando a excelência em serviços e uma gestão sustentável.

Desde o início de nossas atividades florestais, fazemos questão de adotar práticas de manejo responsáveis que aliam altíssima produtividade à conservação da biodiversidade em todas as nossas unidades, sendo inclusive considerados referência no setor.Possuímos mais de 150 mil hectares de florestas de eucalipto e áreas de conservação, que também servem de refúgio para mais de 2.4 mil espécies de fauna e flora.

Sobre a Unidade de Negócios Revestimento Cerâmicos:

Por meio das marcas Ceusa e Portinari, nós somos uma das principais fabricantes de revestimentos cerâmicos do Brasil. Oferecemos soluções inovadoras e processos sustentáveis que refletem as maiores tendências do setor. A Portinari é a única marca brasileira do setor que pratica sustentabilidade com certificação LEED Compliance, concedida pelo Scientific Certification Systems – SCS.Já a Ceusa também conta com uma de suas unidades com tecnologia 4.0, em que todo o controle de processo é automatizado e toda movimentação interna é robotizada.

A Castelatto é líder em pisos e revestimentos em concreto arquitetônico. Mais do que uma indústria, somos uma empresa de design que promove visuais exclusivos para o mercado de luxo, atendendo os desafios dos profissionais da arquitetura e alta decoração. Processos produtivos sustentáveis e tecnológicos fazem da Castelatto uma marca reconhecida nacional e internacionalmente, conceitos que associados à inovação, fazem da Castelatto a marca Top Of Mind do setor, e a primeira a pertencer ao Green Building Council Brasil – organização não governamental que visa fomentar construções sustentáveis ao redor do mundo.

Saiba mais sobre a nossa marca em: dex.co

  • Atuar no desenho, desenvolvimento e manutenção de pipelines de dados escaláveis e confiáveis, desde a camada de ingestão até o consumo.

Alinhada à nossa cultura organizacional, cuidamos da vida onde ela estiver, e por aqui, investimos em pessoas e construímos times incríveis. Por isso, a Dexco oferece benefícios e facilidades para seus colaboradores e familiares. Confira:

Uma empresa multinegócios e detentora das marcas Deca, Portinari, Hydra, Duratex, Castelatto, Ceusa e

Durafloor, a Dexco é a maior empresa produtora de painéis de madeira industrializada do Brasil, referência na produção de louças e metais sanitários no hemisfério Sul e uma das maiores fabricantes de revestimentos do país. Com mais de 70 anos de história, e mais de 12 mil colaboradores, a empresa tem sede em São Paulo e conta com 22 unidades industriais e florestais no Brasil e na Colômbia.

Sob a promessa de marca – Viver Ambientes – a Dexco vive um novo momento e concretiza o propósito de oferecer Soluções para Melhor Viver , com perfil centrado no consumidor e busca por facilitar a jornada de construção e reforma, alinhada à sua preocupação com o ESG.

Em 2021 criou o DX Ventures, fundo de Corporate Venture Capital, para investir em startups e scale-ups que consigam endereçar essas questões. Faz parte ainda de uma joint venture – LD Celulose – para a fabricação de celulose solúvel.

Nosso Propósito é oferecer "Soluções para Melhor Viver" e, para isso, buscamos pessoas criativas, abertas ao novo, que saibam trabalhar de forma colaborativa, alinhadas com o nosso propósito e dispostas a trilhar uma jornada de transformação cultural. Por isso, estamos sempre em busca de novos talentos que queiram dividir esse desafio conosco.

Alinhado a nossa cultura, temos como objetivo tornar a Dexco um lugar mais inclusivo, onde os colaboradores possam ser quem realmente são e sejam valorizados pelas suas diferenças. Buscamos talentos com diferentes características e que queiram estar conosco nessa jornada de transformação!

WHO WE ARE

We are a stealth-stage healthcare AI startup that is the missing link in healthcare revenue management, bridging the gap between clinical care and financial operations. We're transforming how primary care clinics capture revenue through innovative AI technology that operates at the intersection of medical documentation, billing, and value-based care compliance.

In an industry where medical providers leave approximately 16% of their revenue uncollected due to insurance denials and compliance gaps, our mission is clear: enable healthcare providers to capture every dollar they've earned while uncovering new revenue opportunities.

Founded by experienced entrepreneurs with successful exits in healthcare technology and backed by advisors from leading health insurance companies, we are building a virtuous cycle that improves both patient care and provider profitability. We've already secured our first client contract and are positioned for a major pilot.

Our technology tackles critical challenges facing healthcare providers :

  • Real-time AI guidance for physicians at point-of-care
  • Automated coding and billing optimization
  • Intelligent claim follow-up to reduce denials
  • Seamless compliance with value-based care requirements

Join us as we build technology that enables healthcare providers to thrive in an era of value-based care, maximizing revenues in primary care at scale.

WHY THIS ROLE IS PERFECT FOR YOU

This is your opportunity to shape production LLM applications that directly impact healthcare revenue and patient care. You'll work on a recently deployed AI system that automates medical coding and billing, evolving it from good to exceptional through meticulous refinement, rigorous testing, and continuous improvement.

You're not just implementing AI solutions—you're building a system that must get medical coding right the first time, understand complex insurance rules that change constantly, learn from denials, and continuously improve. Every line of code you write directly affects whether healthcare providers get paid and patients receive proper care.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Build and Refine AI Products

  • Develop and implement new business rules for medical consultation billing codes, adapting to changes from various insurance providers
  • Propose and implement enhancements to our existing LLM-based products and optimize prompt engineering for maximum accuracy
  • Use AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor as part of your daily workflow to rapidly build and iterate on solutions

2. Ensure Quality and Accuracy

  • Conduct extensive testing in staging environments and perform detailed debugging to ensure business rules are accurately implemented—in healthcare, "mostly right" isn't good enough
  • Verify data consistency from input to output to guarantee the solidity of our AI products
  • Monitor denial patterns and implement feedback loops that continuously improve model accuracy

3. Own the Development Lifecycle

  • Be responsible for the entire process from understanding business rules to deploying and validating code in production
  • Debug complex system integrations and validate AI outputs against medical coding standards

4. Collaborate and Drive Improvement

  • Work closely with AI, Tech, and Data Engineering teams to maintain complete understanding of the end-to-end process
  • Proactively identify critical issues, propose improvements, and stay current with new tools and techniques in the AI and LLM space
  • In the near future, contribute to fine-tuning specialized LLM models with our internal knowledge base

REQUIRED EXPERTISE

1. Technical Skills

  • Strong proficiency in programming languages like Python or Go
  • Hands-on experience building products on top of large language models (LLMs)
  • Experience with LLM APIs (AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or similar)
  • Strong prompt engineering skills with focus on accuracy and consistency
  • Solid understanding of how LLMs work and how to leverage them for production applications
  • Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and databases (PostgreSQL)

2. Mindset & Approach

  • Meticulous attention to detail with a strong capacity for debugging and code validation
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, ever-changing startup environment

title: Principal Ai Engineer - Ai In Healthcare
description:
WHO WE ARE

We are a stealth-stage healthcare AI startup that is the missing link in healthcare revenue management, bridging the gap between clinical care and financial operations. We're transforming how primary care clinics capture revenue through innovative AI technology that operates at the intersection of medical documentation, billing, and value-based care compliance.

In an industry where medical providers leave approximately 16% of their revenue uncollected due to insurance denials and compliance gaps, our mission is clear: enable healthcare providers to capture every dollar they've earned while uncovering new revenue opportunities.

Founded by experienced entrepreneurs with successful exits in healthcare technology and backed by advisors from leading health insurance companies, we are building a virtuous cycle that improves both patient care and provider profitability. We've already secured our first client contract and are positioned for a major pilot.

Our technology tackles critical challenges facing healthcare providers :

  • Real-time AI guidance for physicians at point-of-care
  • Automated coding and billing optimization
  • Intelligent claim follow-up to reduce denials
  • Seamless compliance with value-based care requirements

Join us as we build technology that enables healthcare providers to thrive in an era of value-based care, maximizing revenues in primary care at scale.

WHY THIS ROLE IS PERFECT FOR YOU

This is your opportunity to shape production LLM applications that directly impact healthcare revenue and patient care. You'll work on a recently deployed AI system that automates medical coding and billing, evolving it from good to exceptional through meticulous refinement, rigorous testing, and continuous improvement.

You're not just implementing AI solutions—you're building a system that must get medical coding right the first time, understand complex insurance rules that change constantly, learn from denials, and continuously improve. Every line of code you write directly affects whether healthcare providers get paid and patients receive proper care.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Build and Refine AI Products

  • Develop and implement new business rules for medical consultation billing codes, adapting to changes from various insurance providers
  • Propose and implement enhancements to our existing LLM-based products and optimize prompt engineering for maximum accuracy
  • Use AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor as part of your daily workflow to rapidly build and iterate on solutions

2. Ensure Quality and Accuracy

  • Conduct extensive testing in staging environments and perform detailed debugging to ensure business rules are accurately implemented—in healthcare, "mostly right" isn't good enough
  • Verify data consistency from input to output to guarantee the solidity of our AI products
  • Monitor denial patterns and implement feedback loops that continuously improve model accuracy

3. Own the Development Lifecycle

  • Be responsible for the entire process from understanding business rules to deploying and validating code in production
  • Debug complex system integrations and validate AI outputs against medical coding standards

4. Collaborate and Drive Improvement

  • Work closely with AI, Tech, and Data Engineering teams to maintain complete understanding of the end-to-end process
  • Proactively identify critical issues, propose improvements, and stay current with new tools and techniques in the AI and LLM space
  • In the near future, contribute to fine-tuning specialized LLM models with our internal knowledge base

REQUIRED EXPERTISE

1. Technical Skills

  • Strong proficiency in programming languages like Python or Go
  • Hands-on experience building products on top of large language models (LLMs)
  • Experience with LLM APIs (AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or similar)
  • Strong prompt engineering skills with focus on accuracy and consistency
  • Solid understanding of how LLMs work and how to leverage them for production applications
  • Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and databases (PostgreSQL)

2. Mindset & Approach

  • Meticulous attention to detail with a strong capacity for debugging and code validation
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, ever-changing startup environment
  • Proven ability to learn new tools, frameworks, and business rules quickly
  • A self-starter who can work independently but also collaborate effectively within a small team
  • Possesses a "big picture" perspective, understanding how your work fits into the entire end-to-end process from client data entry to insurance billing

3. Highly Valued Qualifications

  • Experience with AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar
  • Experience working in a startup or similar environment with constant change
  • Familiarity with RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architectures
  • Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar)
  • Previous experience in healthcare technology, particularly with medical coding, billing, or revenue cycle management
  • Healthcare Domain Knowledge: Not required, but you must be willing and able to learn medical coding, billing rules, and insurance requirements quickly. We\'ll teach you what you need to know.

WHAT WE OFFER

1. Unparalleled Growth Opportunity

  • Ground-floor opportunity in a stealth-mode company with massive market potential
  • Direct impact on product direction and technical architecture decisions
  • Opportunity to build and lead a team as we scale

2. Professional Excellence

  • Work alongside world-class engineers and healthcare industry veterans
  • Access to cutting-edge LLM technologies solving complex, real-world problems
  • Opportunity to influence architectural decisions as we scale our AI infrastructure
  • Competitive compensation package with significant equity upside

3. Work-Life Integration

  • Fully remote position with flexible hours accommodating Brazil time zones
  • Fast-paced environment where you\'ll learn constantly and be challenged daily
  • Opportunity to work with prestigious American healthcare clients
  • Meaningful work that directly improves healthcare outcomes and provider sustainability

READY FOR THE CHALLENGE?

If you\'re a principal-level engineer who loves production AI systems, thrives on continuous improvement, obsesses over getting details right, and wants to make a real impact in healthcare, this role offers the perfect combination of technical challenge, business impact, and startup energy.

Apply now and help us transform healthcare revenue management through the power of data and AI.

title: Principal Ai Engineer - Ai In Healthcare
description:
WHO WE ARE

We are a stealth-stage healthcare AI startup that is the missing link in healthcare revenue management, bridging the gap between clinical care and financial operations. We're transforming how primary care clinics capture revenue through innovative AI technology that operates at the intersection of medical documentation, billing, and value-based care compliance.

In an industry where medical providers leave approximately 16% of their revenue uncollected due to insurance denials and compliance gaps, our mission is clear: enable healthcare providers to capture every dollar they've earned while uncovering new revenue opportunities.

Founded by experienced entrepreneurs with successful exits in healthcare technology and backed by advisors from leading health insurance companies, we are building a virtuous cycle that improves both patient care and provider profitability. We've already secured our first client contract and are positioned for a major pilot.

Our technology tackles critical challenges facing healthcare providers :

  • Real-time AI guidance for physicians at point-of-care
  • Automated coding and billing optimization
  • Intelligent claim follow-up to reduce denials
  • Seamless compliance with value-based care requirements

Join us as we build technology that enables healthcare providers to thrive in an era of value-based care, maximizing revenues in primary care at scale.

WHY THIS ROLE IS PERFECT FOR YOU

This is your opportunity to shape production LLM applications that directly impact healthcare revenue and patient care. You'll work on a recently deployed AI system that automates medical coding and billing, evolving it from good to exceptional through meticulous refinement, rigorous testing, and continuous improvement.

You're not just implementing AI solutions—you're building a system that must get medical coding right the first time, understand complex insurance rules that change constantly, learn from denials, and continuously improve. Every line of code you write directly affects whether healthcare providers get paid and patients receive proper care.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Build and Refine AI Products

  • Develop and implement new business rules for medical consultation billing codes, adapting to changes from various insurance providers
  • Propose and implement enhancements to our existing LLM-based products and optimize prompt engineering for maximum accuracy
  • Use AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor as part of your daily workflow to rapidly build and iterate on solutions

2. Ensure Quality and Accuracy

  • Conduct extensive testing in staging environments and perform detailed debugging to ensure business rules are accurately implemented—in healthcare, "mostly right" isn't good enough
  • Verify data consistency from input to output to guarantee the solidity of our AI products
  • Monitor denial patterns and implement feedback loops that continuously improve model accuracy

3. Own the Development Lifecycle

  • Be responsible for the entire process from understanding business rules to deploying and validating code in production
  • Debug complex system integrations and validate AI outputs against medical coding standards

4. Collaborate and Drive Improvement

  • Work closely with AI, Tech, and Data Engineering teams to maintain complete understanding of the end-to-end process
  • Proactively identify critical issues, propose improvements, and stay current with new tools and techniques in the AI and LLM space
  • In the near future, contribute to fine-tuning specialized LLM models with our internal knowledge base

REQUIRED EXPERTISE

1. Technical Skills

  • Strong proficiency in programming languages like Python or Go
  • Hands-on experience building products on top of large language models (LLMs)
  • Experience with LLM APIs (AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or similar)
  • Strong prompt engineering skills with focus on accuracy and consistency
  • Solid understanding of how LLMs work and how to leverage them for production applications
  • Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and databases (PostgreSQL)

2. Mindset & Approach

  • Meticulous attention to detail with a strong capacity for debugging and code validation
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, ever-changing startup environment
  • Proven ability to learn new tools, frameworks, and business rules quickly
  • A self-starter who can work independently but also collaborate effectively within a small team
  • Possesses a "big picture" perspective, understanding how your work fits into the entire end-to-end process from client data entry to insurance billing

3. Highly Valued Qualifications

  • Experience with AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar
  • Experience working in a startup or similar environment with constant change
  • Familiarity with RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architectures
  • Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar)
  • Previous experience in healthcare technology, particularly with medical coding, billing, or revenue cycle management
  • Healthcare Domain Knowledge: Not required, but you must be willing and able to learn medical coding, billing rules, and insurance requirements quickly. We\'ll teach you what you need to know.

WHAT WE OFFER

1. Unparalleled Growth Opportunity

  • Ground-floor opportunity in a stealth-mode company with massive market potential
  • Direct impact on product direction and technical architecture decisions
  • Opportunity to build and lead a team as we scale

2. Professional Excellence

  • Work alongside world-class engineers and healthcare industry veterans
  • Access to cutting-edge LLM technologies solving complex, real-world problems
  • Opportunity to influence architectural decisions as we scale our AI infrastructure
  • Competitive compensation package with significant equity upside

3. Work-Life Integration

  • Fully remote position with flexible hours accommodating Brazil time zones
  • Fast-paced environment where you\'ll learn constantly and be challenged daily
  • Opportunity to work with prestigious American healthcare clients
  • Meaningful work that directly improves healthcare outcomes and provider sustainability

READY FOR THE CHALLENGE?

If you\'re a principal-level engineer who loves production AI systems, thrives on continuous improvement, obsesses over getting details right, and wants to make a real impact in healthcare, this role offers the perfect combination of technical challenge, business impact, and startup energy.

Apply now and help us transform healthcare revenue management through the power of data and AI.
